title: Raising Premium on a Pass and Trip Protection Plan
content:
Premium owed for cover under a Pass and Trip Protection plan is carried on the plan's own protection account
rather than left standing outside it. Raising it books the amount against the plan and the premium still to be
collected on that plan rises by exactly that amount, the protection account balance being the sum of
everything raised on it less everything paid against it. The household sees the amount on the plan's
protection account and is asked for it in the ordinary way the plan is collected.

**How the premium is raised.** The tool `present_plan_premium_8deb00b0` is unlocked and then called by the
desk. One call books a single premium entry of the amount given against the named plan, tied to the holding
the cover is written over.

**What is passed to it.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `protection_plan_id` | The reference number of the protection plan the premium is raised on, as the protection plan lookup returns it | The reference as the lookup returns it |
| `covered_holding_id` | The reference number of the holding the plan is written over, read from the covered holding field of that plan | The reference as that field holds it |
| `premium_amount_usd` | The premium raised by this entry, in USD | A plain number to 2 decimal places, such as 123.45, with no currency symbol and no thousands separator; it is booked to the cent exactly as passed |

**What comes back.** A single line of confirmation text naming the new protection account entry reference, the
protection plan it was booked on and the premium raised in USD to the cent. The line beginning with the word
Raised is the receipt that the entry was booked; any other wording means nothing was booked.
